messages.author: mika
messages.body: Welcome to the crew space! Everything lives here now — events, gear talk, and June's increasingly cinematic trick videos.

messages.author: oscar
messages.body: Hi all — bought my first pair of skates (FR2s). Any advice for someone whose only trick is 'controlled panic'?

messages.author: dee
messages.body: Welcome Oscar! Rule one: bend your knees. Rule two: grass is a legitimate brake. Come Sunday, we'll get you rolling.

messages.author: lena
messages.body: Sunrise skate along the harbour this morning — 22km before coffee. The path by the new bridge is finally open and it is BUTTER.

messages.author: mika
messages.body: Sunday session: meet 10:00 at the fountain, roll to the riverside park, picnic after. Bring water, sunscreen, and Dee brings the speaker. RSVP with a 🛼.

messages.author: lena
messages.body: In! I'll scout the route Saturday and flag any gravel patches near the underpass.

messages.author: oscar
messages.body: Coming — someone please stand between me and the river.

messages.author: june
messages.body: Bringing the drone if the wind behaves. Group shot at the bridge at golden hour?

messages.author: dee
messages.body: Bigger idea: end-of-summer jam at the skatepark. Mini comp, BBQ, beginner clinic in the morning. We'd need the park booked and a small budget. Thoughts?

messages.author: mika
messages.body: Love it. I'll check park availability for the last weekend of August and draft a budget in #organizers.

messages.author: lena
messages.body: I can run the beginner clinic if we do it before it gets hot. Oscar, you'd be my star pupil.

messages.author: ravi
messages.body: Wheel review after 300km: the 80mm Supremes wear evenly and grip well in the wet, but they're loud on rough tarmac. 8/10, would buy again at the sale price.

messages.author: lena
messages.body: Seconding the wet grip. I did the marathon route in light rain on these and never once thought about it. That's the review.

messages.author: oscar
messages.body: Do I actually need ceramic bearings or is that a tax on beginners? The shop guy was VERY convincing.

messages.author: ravi
messages.body: Tax. Clean ABEC-7s outlast dirty ceramics every time. Spend the difference on pads — see the buying checklist we're building in the Gear add-on.

messages.author: dee
messages.body: +1. Also your frames are fine, your wheels are fine, everything is fine — skate more, shop less. (Says the person with four setups.)

messages.author: dee
messages.body: FINALLY locked the soul grind on the round rail. Three months of sliding off like a cartoon. Clip incoming once June works her magic.

messages.author: june
messages.body: Uploaded the raw clip to the channel — slow-mo version tonight. The lock-in at 0:14 is textbook, frame it.

messages.author: oscar
messages.body: Watched it five times. I understand nothing and respect everything.

messages.author: june
messages.body: Spot alert: the new plaza by the station has perfect ledges and NOBODY there on weekday evenings. Bringing lights Thursday for a night session.

messages.author: dee
messages.body: Thursday works. Someone tell Ravi the ledges are concrete so he can pre-review the wax situation.

messages.author: mika
messages.body: Park quote for the jam: 120 for the morning slot incl. insurance. BBQ we can cover with a 5-per-head chip-in. I'll draft the permit form this week.

messages.author: dee
messages.body: Works. Let's cap the comp at 20 entries and keep prizes silly — golden bearing trophy, best bail award, that kind of thing.

messages.author: mika
messages.body: city published the riverside bowl plans!! https://oslo.kommune.no/parker/riverside-bowl — public comment closes friday. GO COMMENT, this is our chance

messages.author: ravi
messages.body: bearing shootout results are in: https://github.com/ravimenon/bearing-lab/blob/main/results-q3.md — the 12€ ones beat the 40€ ones. I'm as upset as you are

messages.author: lena
messages.body: saturday sunrise route, 28k, two coffee stops: https://www.komoot.com/tour/blade-loop-28k — flat as a pancake. oscar, you're ready for this one

messages.author: lena
messages.body: this morning, 06:12. worth it

messages.author: june
messages.body: sunday's edit is UP 🎬 https://youtube.com/watch?v=bc-sunday-cut — oscar's first clean stop at 2:14, crowd goes wild

messages.author: june
messages.body: stills from the session while the edit renders — that light was unreal

messages.author: mika
messages.body: CPH TRIP DUMP 🇩🇰 — three days, four parks, zero broken bones. @june's clip from Fælledparken coming soon

messages.author: dee
messages.body: the harbour line shot is POSTER material. @june please make prints

messages.author: oscar
messages.body: I was only lost twice, personal best

messages.author: lena
messages.body: the hostel-to-park route was 11k of pure glide. posting it to komoot tonight
